description: Runs check, inspect, bake, or sweep. check validates a spec and returns the report inline, at no charge. inspect measures or compares a finished job by job_id, at no charge. bake and sweep start an async job, charge for completed work, and return the job, waiting up to wait_ms. Batches and sweeps need accept_quote, including free repeats. When a bake is above the usual price and accept_quote or max_price_usd is missing, returns PRICE_ACCEPT_REQUIRED with the quote, and nothing runs or is charged.

accept_quote.description: Quote id (q_...). Required for every batch and sweep, including at the usual price.

batch.description: Run variations in list, axis and seed order.

compare_job_id.description: Earlier job to compare with job_id.

detail.description: compact (the default, also called files): state, charge and each artifact once, plus one signed download base and a zip URL. lean is the same with less QA. full is the large report and a signed URL per file. status is per-job or per-variant state and charge only.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key. A retry with the same key and body returns the original job. A different body returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Without a key, an identical bake within 10 minutes of a succeeded job for this API key returns that job and is not charged again.

image.description: Include a framed inspect still when available. False returns numbers only.

inputs.description: Registered input files, named in the spec by `as`.

max_cost_usd.description: Refuse (COST_LIMIT) if this job would cost more. Batches and sweeps also require the accepted quote ID.

max_price_usd.description: Maximum price in US dollars. Every batch and sweep also requires accept_quote.

measure_between.description: Two positioned part paths to measure in metres.

module.description: Module id. pyro and pyrofx are the same fire, smoke, dust and explosion module. meshfx takes one GLB. geofx takes a .geo.toml terrain spec and up to four inputs. Optional when spec_name ends in a module extension.

operation.description: Check a spec or inspect a finished job inline for free. Bake and sweep create jobs.

quality.description: draft or final. Bakes default to final. Batches and sweeps default to draft.

spec.description: The spec as TOML text, or the same tree as a JSON object. Fields come from the module schema.

sweep.description: For operation sweep: one {key, values}, or a list of axes with different keys.

terrain_shadows.description: geofx horizon sectors. Zero disables terrain shadows.

wait_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the job to finish, up to 35 seconds.

name: submit
title: Run an operation
